attchmntText: Transcript of Earnings Call for Q2 and H1 FY27 Results held on November 12, 2026
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings call with BSE and NSE on November 18, 2026. The call was held on November 12, 2026. In H1 FY27, platform premium grew 52% to INR 2,419 crores. Revenue increased 38% to INR 637 crores. Service EBITDA rose 66% to INR 85 crores. The company added 69,000 new digital partners, reaching a base of 7,28,000. Active digital partners numbered 96,368. Management discussed proposed regulations affecting POSPs. They noted the removal of product caps in health, life, and SME segments. The company highlighted its tech-enabled distribution model and AI initiatives. Ninja AI assistants were launched to support agents. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 47 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose herewith the newspaper advertisement for the publication of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 in the following newspapers on November 13, 2026:1. Financial Express   English2. Navshakti   Marathi
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited published its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Financial Express and Navshakti on November 13, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 12, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 342.19 million, compared to Rs. 294.98 million in the previous quarter. The consolidated net loss for the quarter was Rs. 25.83 million. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was Rs. 637.17 million, with a net loss of Rs. 63.61 million. Standalone revenue for the quarter was Rs. 15.83 million, with a net loss of Rs. 33.23 million. The standalone half-year revenue was Rs. 36.60 million, with a net loss of Rs. 68.78 million. Earnings per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was negative Rs. 0.88 on a consolidated basis and negative Rs. 1.11 on a standalone basis.
